title: Service Contracts: when and by how much may the contract term be extended?
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product governs the extension of a contract's term by amendment: from when an extension may be requested, how far one extension may move the expiry date, and how many extensions a contract may take.

## Formal clauses
1. A term extension may be requested only from the tier's extension window, in calendar days, before the contract expires.
2. The window opens on the expiry date minus the tier's window days, counted on calendar dates, and a request on the opening day is inside it.
3. An extension moves the expiry date by at most the tier's longest single extension.
4. A contract takes at most the tier's number of extensions.

## The time test at a glance
| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event the window is counted back from | the expiry of the contract |
| Record relied on | the expiry date on the line's record of that contract |
| Length | the tier's extension window, in calendar days |
| Opening day | the expiry date minus the window days, counted on calendar dates |
| Comparison | the request must not be earlier than the opening day |
| Request on the opening day | inside the window |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical 40-day window, for illustration only)
A contract expires on 2026-11-30, so a 40-day window opens on 2026-10-21.
- Request on 2026-10-20: before the opening day; not yet possible.
- Request on 2026-10-21, the opening day: inside the window.
- Request on 2026-11-10: inside the window.

## Length and number (hypothetical figures)
- With a longest single extension of 45 days, the 2026-11-30 expiry date may move to 2027-01-14 at the latest; a request for a new expiry date of 2027-01-20 moves it further than one extension allows.
- With 2 extensions allowed per contract, a contract already extended twice cannot take a third.
